variants.name: Officier de l’audience
variants.description: Tall lean adult male Yautja with grey-olive skin and sparse warm brown freckles, an old temple scar and long dark tendrils tied with flat bronze rings. Elegant dark green layered court tunic, short bone-trimmed shoulder mantle, ivory woven sash. Holds a long narrow closed audience record case across forearms. Dignified administrative court member, no crown.
variants.prompt:
FACIAL ANATOMY PRIORITY: reference image1 is a close-up photograph of the actual original1987 Predator animatronic face, from the official Stan Winston School production archive. Use it for the actual skull and mandible structure. Reference image2 is the game role/style atlas only. Draw a recognizable classic cinema Yautja face: broad back-swept cranial dome, deep angular brow above small recessed eyes, a recessed inner mouth with small teeth, FOUR separate fleshy hinged external mandibles surrounding it (two upper cheek mandibles with hooked tusks and two larger lower mandibles). All four must read clearly, slightly parted in a calm expression, attached outside the inner mouth. The face turns three-quarter toward viewer so both sides of the mandible structure are visible while body angles screen-right. Never a human nose, lips, beard or an orc/pig snout, never a pair of tubes or just two downward tusks. Dense thick scalp quills/tendrils are anatomy, not human hair. No mask hiding anatomy. Preserve classic film proportions while varying individual scarring and markings. Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE individual transparent full-body PNG NPC sprite for Yautja La Longue Chasse. SECOND image is game STYLE/camera/material reference: top-left chief clothing, adapted here for an adult MEMBER OF THE KING'S COURT. All20 are court attendants and representatives; not20 kings. Classical alien anatomy from photo1 has priority over simplified atlas faces. Keep the species anatomy but create a new individual's proportions, markings and scars; do not clone the photo's exact pigmentation pattern. Hand-painted realistic fantasy science-fiction game rendering, rich natural cloth, weathered bronze, carved bone. Mostly civilian diplomatic court garments, no giant battle armor, no human medieval crown. Face near-front three-quarter, body gently toward screen-right, slight elevated orthographic view. Entire body, all dread tendrils, hands, tools and both clawed feet within a clear8percent margin; one figure about80percent of canvas height. Actual transparent alpha, no scenery, floor, cast shadow, extra person, animals, inscription, reference photo, watermark or logo. Calm standing posture. Fully covering adult clothing. Preserve distinct silhouette, pose, facial markings, tendril arrangement and outfit for this variant.

Elegant dark green layered court tunic, short bone-trimmed shoulder mantle, ivory woven sash. Holds a long narrow closed audience record case across forearms. Dignified administrative court member, no crown.
